boards.title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
boards.description: Ten named MSOE study environments, spanning library, academic, residential, and campus-community spaces.

cards.title: Walter Schroeder Library
cards.subtitle: 500 E. Kilbourn Ave. • Library study and research areas
cards.notes: Choose this for independent research or a group session, then use the library’s study-room booking option when a private collaboration space is needed.
cards.short_summary: A library setting with research resources, individual study areas, and reservable group rooms.
cards.evidence_claim: MSOE says the Walter Schroeder Library has spaces to research, study, and collaborate, including study rooms that can be booked for private project work.
cards.access_notes: MSOE states that visitors must scan an MSOE ID card to enter the library; study rooms are booked through the library.

cards.title: Raider Center for Academic Success
cards.subtitle: Inside Walter Schroeder Library
cards.notes: Pair a study block with tutoring or writing help here; confirm the available support and scheduling details through the RCAS tutoring link before visiting.
cards.short_summary: A library-based academic-support setting with tutoring, writing help, and study space.
cards.evidence_claim: MSOE identifies RCAS as located in the library and providing tutoring, writing help, and study spaces.
cards.access_notes: Located in the Walter Schroeder Library; use RCAS tutoring information to confirm support availability.

cards.title: Campus Center
cards.subtitle: 1025 N. Broadway • Between-class study setting
cards.notes: Use the Campus Center for a study session between classes, and choose a seating area away from games or dining activity if you need more focus.
cards.short_summary: A centrally located campus building MSOE identifies as a place to study between classes.
cards.evidence_claim: MSOE describes the Campus Center as a resource for students looking for a place to study between classes.
cards.access_notes: Campus Center is at 1025 N. Broadway; MSOE also describes it as containing student services, classrooms, and offices.

cards.title: Robert Spitzer Dining Commons
cards.subtitle: Campus Center, third floor • Dining and study commons
cards.notes: Use an open table for collaborative reading or planning, and remember that entering the servery requires an MSOE ID swipe or a guest meal pass.
cards.short_summary: A Campus Center gathering area that combines dining, meeting, study, and game spaces.
cards.evidence_claim: MSOE says the Robert Spitzer Dining Commons includes places to meet and study spaces, and is its central gathering location.
cards.access_notes: Located on the third floor of the Campus Center. MSOE states students swipe an ID to enter the servery; guests may buy a meal pass.

cards.title: Tree Lounge
cards.subtitle: MSOE campus • Named lounge and study space
cards.notes: Bring a compact task and use this named lounge as an alternative to the library; check campus signage or Student Support Services for its current location.
cards.short_summary: A named campus lounge MSOE lists among its places to study.
cards.evidence_claim: MSOE’s Commuter Services page lists Tree Lounge among campus lounges and study spaces.
cards.access_notes: MSOE lists Tree Lounge as a campus study space; the cited page does not state hours or reservation requirements.

cards.title: Hermann Viets Tower Collaboration Hubs
cards.subtitle: 1121 N. Milwaukee St. • Glass-enclosed two-story hubs
cards.notes: If you live in Viets Tower, use a collaboration hub for a group whiteboard session and keep noise compatible with the shared residential setting.
cards.short_summary: Two-story, glass-enclosed residential collaboration spaces designed for study and group work.
cards.evidence_claim: MSOE says Viets Tower has two-story collaboration hubs and that its collaborative study spaces include flexible furniture and whiteboards.
cards.access_notes: In Hermann Viets Tower, a residence hall at 1121 N. Milwaukee St.; access is tied to the residential building.

cards.entity_name: Hermann Viets Tower Ground-Floor Study Space
cards.title: Viets Tower Ground-Floor Study Space
cards.subtitle: 1121 N. Milwaukee St. • Ground floor
cards.notes: For a shorter focused session inside the residence hall, use the designated ground-floor study space rather than a dining or circulation area.
cards.short_summary: A specifically identified study space on the ground floor of Viets Tower.
cards.evidence_claim: MSOE’s Viets Tower page identifies a study space on the building’s ground floor.
cards.access_notes: Located within Hermann Viets Tower, a residence hall; the cited page does not state public-access hours.

cards.title: Rosenberg Hall Study Lounge
cards.subtitle: 1235 N. Milwaukee St. • Rader School of Business building
cards.notes: Use the study lounge for a focused work block near business classrooms and the Innovent Center; verify building access around your planned visit.
cards.short_summary: A named study lounge in Rosenberg Hall alongside academic and innovation spaces.
cards.evidence_claim: MSOE states that Rosenberg Hall contains the Rader School of Business, Innovent Center, classrooms, laboratories, offices, and a study lounge.
cards.access_notes: Rosenberg Hall is at 1235 N. Milwaukee St.; the cited page does not state lounge hours or reservation requirements.

cards.entity_name: Diercks Computational Science Hall Collaborative Spaces
cards.title: Diercks Hall Collaborative Spaces
cards.subtitle: Diercks Computational Science Hall • Collaborative work setting
cards.notes: Use the collaborative spaces for project discussion or shared screen work, and confirm room availability if your group needs a particular setup.
cards.short_summary: A campus academic building MSOE identifies as having collaborative spaces.
cards.evidence_claim: MSOE identifies Diercks Hall as one of the campus locations where students can find collaborative spaces.
cards.source_title: New dining commons coming to MSOE Campus Center | MSOE
cards.access_notes: The cited MSOE page identifies collaborative spaces in Diercks Hall but does not state individual-room access or hours.

cards.title: stART Lab Study Space
cards.subtitle: MSOE campus • Collaborative study location
cards.notes: Consider this setting for a collaborative study session, and verify current availability with MSOE before relying on it for a scheduled group meeting.
cards.short_summary: A named MSOE location listed among campus collaborative and study spaces.
cards.evidence_claim: MSOE lists the stART Lab among campus locations where students can find collaborative spaces.
cards.source_title: New dining commons coming to MSOE Campus Center | MSOE
cards.access_notes: The cited MSOE page lists the stART Lab as a collaborative-space location; it does not state hours or reservation rules.
